snippet.title: Riziki – Official Alpha PlayTest Trailer | Dance to the Beat of Africa
snippet.description:
Step into the rhythm of Africa with Riziki, a new mobile rhythm game celebrating African music, dance, and culture. From Afrobeat to Amapiano, play through iconic tracks, unlock dances, and immerse yourself in the spirit of the continent.

Follow us on our journey and join the movement.
🔗 Join us as a playtester :https://linktr.ee/weza.africa
🔗 Play the demo: https://wezaie.itch.io/riziki
🌍 Stay connected: https://linktr.ee/weza.africa

#RizikiGame #AfricanGames #RhythmGame #DanceGame #WezaInteractive
